nodes.label: run()
nodes.desc: Entry point: parses CLI options, decides pattern type and smart case, builds the matcher and Config, then hands everything to walk::scan.

nodes.label: Opts (clap)
nodes.desc: Clap-derive option struct; includes -u/--unrestricted as an alias for --no-ignore --hidden.

nodes.label: build_patterns
nodes.desc: Turns user patterns into a Matcher: RegexSet, GlobSet, FixedStrings or MatchAll; RegexSet matches only when every pattern hits.

nodes.label: walk::scan
nodes.desc: Orchestrator: WorkerState::scan builds the walker, opens a bounded channel and spawns sender/receiver threads.

nodes.label: build_walker
nodes.desc: Configures ignore::WalkBuilder: gitignore/parent/global rules, .fdignore, hidden files, max depth, threads; returns WalkParallel.

nodes.label: spawn_senders
nodes.desc: Per-thread worker closure: applies every filter in a cheap-to-expensive order and ships surviving entries as batches.

nodes.label: ReceiverBuffer
nodes.desc: Receiver thread: buffers results for up to 100 ms to sort them; if the walk is slow it switches to streaming mode.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.desc: Immutable struct carrying every search knob (threads, filters, colors, quiet mode) shared by all stages.

nodes.label: DirEntry
nodes.desc: Wrapper around ignore::DirEntry with lazily cached metadata and ls-colors style so stats are only fetched when needed.

nodes.label: print_entry
nodes.desc: Writes one entry: hyperlinks, colors, custom separators, --format templates, NUL terminator.

edges.label: Batch of WorkerResults over bounded channel
